requiredFaithfulCharacterizations: Actual default producer replaces an existing dictionary value and preserves unrelated entries.
Actual deserialized patch object value reaches the target as the observed runtime representation, not an assumed synthetic precondition.
Programmatic already-typed replacement preserves reference identity and skips its registered value converter.
Existing null slot is distinguished from a missing storage reference.
Missing target rejects without invoking a value converter and leaves data unchanged.
Actual custom value converter can resize the same concrete dictionary before final replacement.
Actual custom value converter can clear the dictionary and insert another entry; final indexer replacement re-adds the original key without corrupting the other entry.
Invalid conversion preserves the old value and error contract.
Null, nullable boxed value, ordinal-ignore-case key, empty dictionary and invalid key partitions preserve their actual original behavior.
Actual default does not select DictionaryAdapter for a custom IDictionary merely because a direct internal test could invoke it.

measurement.boundary: Prepared actual public ApplyTo plus consumed readback/error observation. JSON patch deserialization/setup is outside timing. Not isolated dictionary probes, HTTP, endpoint or whole-application performance.

Run relevant existing tests and new focused preservation cases on original and candidate where an optimization is implemented.
